title: larvae.toml
description: Configuration for larvae, one toolchain for all of Luau: transforms today, formatting and linting next.

profile.description: Per-environment overlays selected with --profile <name>. Tables deep-merge per key; arrays and scalars are replaced whole.

aliases.description: Require aliases. Optional: .luaurc aliases work with zero config; entries here merge over them per key. Values are @game/... DataModel paths or filesystem paths. "@self" and "@game" are reserved.

additionalProperties.description: A DataModel path ("@game/ReplicatedStorage/packages") or a filesystem path ("./Packages/signal").

process.description: What to read, where to write, how to print.

input.description: Source directory, or a list of them. One root flattens into the output, several keep their own directory so two roots cannot collide.

generator.description: Output printer. retain-lines preserves formatting, comments, and line numbers. dense and readable land in M4.

quotes.description: Quote style for require strings in the output. preserve keeps whatever the source used, double/single requote every require string and generated instance expression.

requires.description: The require-rewriting transform. Input semantics are always Luau-RFC "luau" mode.

target.description: roblox-string: native @game/./@self string requires. path: relative filesystem paths (Lune). roblox-instance: Instance expressions like script.Parent:FindFirstChild("x") (see indexing_style).

sourcemap.description: Path to a rojo sourcemap.json. Rojo's own file to instance map, which settles the cases a project file cannot describe on its own. It wins over auto mounts and is part of the cache key, so a stale one cannot produce stale requires.

mounts.description: Fallback filesystem->DataModel mapping; rarely needed with a Rojo project file. Keys are directories relative to the project root.

strict.description: Upgrade warn-level classes (missing target file, case mismatch) to errors. Unknown aliases and inexpressible/realm-violating requires are ALWAYS errors.

instance_input.description: Read require(script.Parent.Foo) style requires as input and rewrite them to the configured target. Turn it off to leave instance requires exactly as written.

overrides.description: A different require target for the paths a glob matches, relative to [process].input. First match wins. The value is a target name, or a table with target and indexing_style.

indexing_style.description: roblox-instance target only: how emitted Instance chains index children. find_first_child -> :FindFirstChild("x"), wait_for_child -> :WaitForChild("x"), property -> .x (the dot format). Kebab-case spellings are accepted too.

rojo.description: Rojo project integration: auto-derived mounts and the derived build project in .larvae/.

build_project.description: Override the derived build project location (default: <cache_dir>/build.project.json).

defines.description: Compile-time constants, injected as globals and constant-folded. Override per profile for dev/release builds.

rule.description: false = off (default), true = on, or a table with rule options and per-rule file filters (apply_to/skip globs).

rules.description: Builtin transforms, all off by default. Every darklua rule name is accepted so configs port over 1:1. Rules that are not implemented yet error at load time naming their milestone. darklua's convert_require lives in [requires], inject_global_value in [defines], remove_spaces in the dense generator.

const_requires.description: larvae only. Turn `local X = require(...)` into `const X = require(...)`. Skips multi bindings and annotated locals. Implemented.

remove_comments.description: Remove comments. `true`, or a table with `except` regexes for comments to keep (defaults to ["^--!"] so Luau directives survive; set [] to match darklua). Implemented.

append_text_comment.description: Insert a comment at the start or end of every file. Implemented.

text.description: Literal comment text, mutually exclusive with file

file.description: Read the comment text from this file

add_luau_directive.description: larvae only. Write a Luau directive at the top of every file, ex: "strict" emits --!strict. An existing directive of the same family is left alone. Implemented.

remove_calls.description: larvae only. Remove statement position calls to the named functions, ex: print or debug.profilebegin. Names may be dotted paths; method calls and computed callees are never matched, and a call whose value is used is left alone. Implemented.

preserve_arguments_side_effects.description: Keep calls whose arguments call something, since that inner call may be the point of the line

use_get_service.description: larvae only. Rewrite `game.Players` into `game:GetService("Players")` for the known services, which keeps working when a service is renamed or not created yet. A local named game defeats it. Implemented.

dedupe_requires.description: larvae only. Top level `local X = require(...)` statements that resolve to the same module collapse, the later ones become aliases of the first. Skips const, annotated and multi binding locals. Implemented.

inject_module_path.description: larvae only. Name of a constant defined at the top of every file that references it, holding that file's DataModel path, ex: "@game/ReplicatedStorage/shared/util". Warns when no mount covers the file. Implemented.

freeze_module.description: larvae only. Wrap a module's returned table in `table.freeze`, only when nothing can write to it, so field writes, rebinds and metatable patterns turn the rule off for that file. Implemented.

compute_expression.description: Fold constant expressions to their value. Only folds when the result prints back exactly, so fractions, values past exact double range and strings holding escapes are left alone. Implemented.

convert_function_to_assignment.description: Rewrite `function foo()` into `foo = function()`, and `function o:m()` into `o.m = function(self)`. Attributed functions are left alone. Implemented.

convert_index_to_field.description: Rewrite `t["field"]` into `t.field`, and the same for table constructor keys, when the literal spells a valid name that is not a reserved word. Implemented.

convert_local_function_to_assign.description: Rewrite `local function f()` into `local f = function()`, only when the body never mentions f, since the local form is in scope inside itself. Implemented.

convert_luau_number.description: Rewrite binary literals like 0b1010 as hex and strip digit separators, both being Luau only syntax. Implemented.

convert_square_root_call.description: Rewrite `math.sqrt(x)` into `(x ^ 0.5)`. The result is always parenthesised so it survives being the base of another power. Implemented.

filter_after_early_return.description: Delete the statements after a `do ... return ... end` block, which can never run. Stops if a type alias is among them, since an exported one is visible outside the block. Implemented.

group_local_assignment.description: Merge a run of adjacent local declarations into one. Conservative, it stops at a call, a dependency between them, an annotation, a comment or anything but whitespace in between. Implemented.

make_assignment_local.description: Turn a `const` declaration back into a `local` one, the inverse of const_requires, for output that has to stay plain Lua. Implemented.

preserve_arguments_side_effects.description: Keep calls whose arguments call something, since that inner call may be the point of the line

remove_attribute.description: Strip function attributes, ex: @native. `true` removes every one, or a table with `match` regexes tested against the attribute name without its @. Implemented.

match.description: Regexes tested against the attribute name, empty means every attribute

remove_compound_assignment.description: Expand `x += 1` into `x = x + 1` for every compound operator. Targets that would have to run code twice, ex: a computed key holding a call, are left alone. Implemented.

remove_continue.description: Rewrite a loop containing `continue` into the `repeat ... until true` form with `continue` spelled `break`. Loops that also break at the same level, and repeat loops whose condition can read body locals, are left alone. Implemented.

preserve_arguments_side_effects.description: Keep calls whose arguments call something, since that inner call may be the point of the line

remove_empty_do.description: Drop `do end` blocks that contain nothing. A lone semicolon counts as content. Nested empties shed one layer per run. Implemented.

remove_floor_division.description: Rewrite `a // b` into `math.floor(a / b)`, and `a //= b` into `a = math.floor(a / b)`. Implemented.

remove_function_call_parens.description: Rewrite `f("x")` into `f"x"` and `f({})` into `f{}` when a call takes exactly one string or table argument. Implemented.

remove_if_expression.description: Rewrite `if c then a else b` into `c and a or b`. Only applied when the then value can never be false or nil, otherwise the and/or form would not be equivalent and the expression is left alone. Implemented.

remove_interpolated_string.description: Rewrite backtick strings into string.format calls. `true`, or a table with `strategy`, "string" wraps each value in tostring and formats with %s, "tostring" uses Luau's %*. Multi line and nested backtick strings are left alone. Implemented.

remove_method_call.description: Rewrite `obj:m(x)` into `obj.m(obj, x)`. Only for a plain identifier receiver, anything else would be evaluated twice. Implemented.

remove_method_definition.description: Rewrite `function C:m()` into `function C.m(self)`, making the implicit self parameter explicit. Implemented.

remove_nil_declaration.description: Rewrite `local x = nil` into `local x` and drop trailing nil values from multi bindings. Skips const, which must keep a value. Implemented.

remove_types.description: Strip every type annotation, bindings, parameters, return types, generic lists, type aliases and the tail of a `::` assertion. Implemented.

remove_unused_if_branch.description: Prune if branches whose condition is a known constant. A branch that always runs is unwrapped, or becomes a `do` block when it declares locals so their scope is preserved. Implemented.

remove_unused_variable.description: Remove unused locals and local functions.

remove_unused_while.description: Delete a while loop whose condition is a constant false. Implemented.

rename_variables.description: Rename locals and params to short names.

worms.description: Worms, extensions loaded from a GitHub release. A worm is Luau source or a wasm32 module in a zip carrying a worm.toml. The key names the worm and its settings live under [config.<key>]. (M3)

version.description: Release tag to pin, without a leading v.

asset.description: Release asset to fetch. Defaults to <key>-worm.zip, then worm.zip.

bundle.description: Single-file bundling with deterministic module-init ordering. Present = enabled. (M3)

tree_shake.description: Drop modules unreachable from the entry point.

loaders.description: Data files required as modules are converted to Lua tables (glob -> loader).

trace_map.description: Emit a mapping file for stack-trace deobfuscation.

disallow_unused_modules.description: Files unreachable from any entry point.

realm_analysis.description: Error when client-reachable code requires server-only containers.

early_require_diagnostics.description: Flag string requires reachable from early client entry points (no wait semantics).

native_expressible.description: Flag emitted requires that can't be native string form.
